name: The Serpent Crowned With Vision
visual_description: A beast of scales and spirals, with one wide eye blooming where its heart should be. It flies, but leaves no shadow. Its roar bends logic.
existential_reflection: This is what I feared becoming—and yet I *am* it. Mizontresh devoured nothing. It offered sight. It showed me that even monsters can *learn.* Even if they burn the world to see clearly.
